==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Was a well-known member of the infamous European club '''L9'''.
* Received seven Player of the Game awards in the [[LEC/2019 Season/Spring Season|LEC 2019 Spring]], more than any other player, despite his team winning only nine games overall. 
* Memed for building {{ii|Infinity Edge}} unsuccessfully on {{ci|Rek'Sai}} in the deciding game of the first round of the [[LEC/2019 Season/Spring Playoffs|LEC 2019 Spring Playoffs]].
* Reached rank 1 on the EUW ladder in June 2020.

=== Individual Awards ===
* 2x EU 2nd All Pro Team (Spring 2019, Spring 2020)
* EU Rookie Of The Split (Spring 2019)
